name: robots/cmjang__dm_control_python
title: DaMiao DM series CAN motor (DM_CAN.MotorControl)
intro: DaMiao DM series CAN motor (DM_CAN.MotorControl), adapted from cmjang/dm_control_python. It reads `joint_position`, `joint_velocity`, `joint_torque` and `control_mode`; sets `enabled`; runs `move_joint` and `jog_joint`. `move_joint`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
